subject: AB and BB genotypes switched in output

messages.author: df9da6314e1cf78f
messages.subject: AB and BB genotypes switched in output
parts:
Hi,

It seems like plotPXG and other output functions are swapping the AB and BB genotypes. I attached the plotPXG output compared to the same locus using genotypes from my input file into r/qtl.

The same thing also seems to be happening in write.cross.

The qtl analysis worked as I expected (similar results to a gwas analysis), so it seems like this may be an issue in the formatting of output files.

Thanks,

Lauren

messages.author: df9da6314e1cf78f
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] AB and BB genotypes switched in output
parts:
Hi Karl,

I realized that I could fix the problem by changing the order of the genotypes in the read.cross from this

mapthis=read.cross(format="csv",file="map_with_pheno.csv", genotypes = c("AA", "BB", "AB"))


to this

mapthis=read.cross(format="csv",file="map_with_pheno.csv", genotypes = c("AA", "AB", "BB"))

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thanks for the quick reply
